note: Announcements shown in the launcher (1.3.0+). Patch notes are added automatically from the GitHub releases - do not copy them here.

items.title: New launcher: live server status
items.summary: See which modes are online and how many are playing, before you hit PLAY.
items.body:
The launcher now shows the real state of every server:
- Survival, Extraction and Search & Destroy: online or offline, and how many are playing
- Your ping to the Aethon servers
- Patch notes appear here automatically with every update

Also new:
- Remember me now keeps you signed in for 30 days
- Settings > About > Send logs: if something goes wrong, one click sends us your launcher log
- The launcher updates itself in the background and shows the progress at the top

items.title: Aethon accounts are live
items.summary: Create a username + password in the launcher. One account for every mode.
items.body:
Every server now requires an Aethon account.

1. On the login screen, click Create Account
2. Pick a username (3-16 letters, numbers or _) and a password (8+ characters)
3. Sign in and press PLAY

The name over your head and in chat is your account name. One account works in Survival, Extraction and Search & Destroy.
